sources.entry: Blinko - A personal note tool with AI features. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Blinko is a self-hosted, AI-powered card note-taking app for quickly capturing and organizing fleeting thoughts.
summary.what_it_does: Blinko is positioned as a quick-capture note tool where ideas are jotted down as cards. Notes are stored as plain text with full Markdown support. It offers AI-based retrieval using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), so notes can be searched with natural language queries. The README says data is stored in the user's self-hosted environment. It is built with Tauri and is described as supporting macOS, Windows, Android, and Linux. The README gives a one-line Docker install command, and the project lists its Telegram channels and official docs as resources. The README does not detail the specific AI models or providers used.
use_cases: keeping private notes on own server
running a note app in Docker
notable: AI-powered retrieval using RAG to search notes in natural language
Card-based quick capture for fleeting thoughts
Plain-text storage with full Markdown support
Tauri-based client described for macOS, Windows, Android, and Linux
caveats: The Docker install command in the README is incomplete (the URL is missing), so setup steps are unclear from the README alone
macOS builds that are not notarized may show as damaged and need a manual quarantine attribute removal
README does not specify which AI models or providers are used
